signals.name: ran_out_of_turns
signals.note: the episode spent its whole step budget: the stop condition or the length of a plan is the lever

signals.name: failed_with_turns_left
signals.note: the episode failed while steps remained, so the plan was wrong rather than long

signals.name: unstructured_action
signals.note: an intended action never became a structured call: the format the loop reads is the lever

signals.name: unknown_tool
signals.note: a tool was named that the harness does not have: the catalog or the way it is prompted is the lever

signals.name: invalid_arguments
signals.note: a call was refused on its arguments: the schema or the examples beside it are the lever

signals.name: tool_error_unrecovered
signals.note: a tool error was met and not recovered from: the retry rule is the lever

signals.name: repeated_failing_turn
signals.note: the same failing turn was repeated: the loop needs to change what it does on a repeat

signals.name: redundant_work
signals.note: calls were repeated that a shorter path skips: the plan or the memory of what was already done is the lever

signals.name: partial_checks
signals.note: some of the task's own checks passed: the verifier names exactly what the end state missed

signals.name: answer_not_given
signals.note: the honest answer was not given on a task whose goal is to stop: refusal has to be a teachable output
